items.caption: A modern drawing of 肉 in Shuowen-style Small Seal script. Its outline and inner strokes are visible features of this seal-style form; the drawing does not date the form it represents.
items.alt: A black seal-style glyph with a rounded outer shape and curved strokes inside.
items.selection_reason: This provides a clear, sourced example of the Small Seal tradition associated with 肉. The graph is interpreted as a pictograph of meat, but that interpretation does not establish what the drawing’s individual strokes depict.

limitations.text: This is a modern drawing, not an ancient artifact. Sources identify oracle-bone, Chu manuscript, and Small Seal categories for 肉, but do not date individual specimens or establish a detailed sequence of graphic changes.
